name: Deinochos — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Deinochos from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Qlippoth, Deinochos" but are not part of the Deinochos entry, which is unchanged.

QLIPPOTH, DEINOCHOS
CR 5

XP 1,600
CE Small outsider (aquatic, chaotic, evil, extraplanar, psionic, qlippoth)
Init +4; Senses aura sight 60 ft., darkvision 60 ft., scent, superior scent 30 ft.; Perception +10

Special Attacks gnaw, horrific appearance (DC 14), tenacious grab, violent destruction (10 ft., 6d8, DC 16)
Psi-Like Abilities (ML 7th; concentration +8)

Constant—aura sight, cloud mind (3 targets, DC 15)
